== Course of events ==

Amid the company's adventures in Oz, following their escape from the Gargoyles and Eureka's confession about the missing piglet, Jim races against Sawhorse. Jim loses the contest, and in anger over the defeat he kicks Sawhorse, breaking one of its legs and damaging an ear. Hungry Tiger, witnessing the attack, tackles Jim in response, halting the assault on Sawhorse.

The damage Jim causes to Sawhorse does not go unresolved: it is later addressed when Tin Woodman repairs Sawhorse's broken leg and ear, an act that coincides with Ozma crowning Sawhorse "Prince of Horses."
